name: mechanism_competition_stage_A
question: Which mechanism components (S edge state, L line position, C local copy/modify) carry independent held-out predictive information about the next ZL3b running-text token beyond a four-slot token grammar, under one fixed universal coding scorecard?
population: E007 population: running-text strict tokens, lexicographic folio order; line features from full line token lists; uncertain tokens never coded (feature UNC only)
evidence_class: FROZEN_HOLDOUT for component contrasts; bases known from E007; P70 base NON-PROSPECTIVE
scorecard: voynichlab.mdl.KTCoder prequential KT + char escape; model_bits = base inventory cost + elias_gamma(1+#components) + [C: elias_gamma(W_index+1) + 2]

components.S: last EVA char of previous token in same line; BOL; UNC — appended to every base-slot context
components.L: FIRST/MID/LAST/ONLY in line — appended to every base-slot context
components.C: window of previous W population tokens in same folio; src slot 'k:d' (d=0 exact, d=1 Levenshtein 1) or NONE, context ('src',); edit slot s{p}{c}/i{p}{c}/d{p}, context ('edit',); NONE -> base slots; base counts updated on every token

W_selection.rule: lowest development-only prequential data_bits of B1+C; ties -> smaller W; applied to all C models and holdout

N1.definition: within-folio population-token order shuffle; uncertain tokens fixed; features recomputed

decision_rule: X INFORMATIVE iff on B1: marginal gain>=0.05 AND unique gain>=0.05 AND full beats reduced on >=2/3 holdout folios AND unique gain>0 in Currier A and B AND unique gain - N1 unique gain >=0.05; NOT_INFORMATIVE iff marginal<0.05 and unique<0.05; else MIXED. B0 = robustness (BASE_DEPENDENT if direction differs).

pre_result_predictions.H012_C: marginal>=0.05 expected; unique vs S is the contest

family_readout: ordinal only: copy/modify signature = C INFORMATIVE and Du(C)>=Du(S); sequential signature = S INFORMATIVE; line-unit signature = L INFORMATIVE; no N/C/G decision
degrees_of_freedom: W (4 values, dev-only, charged); nothing else
claim_ceiling: Structural predictive-information claims only; no morphemes/language/cipher/hoax/meaning.
stage_B: DEFERRED: reference corpora (Latin/Italian), Naibbe reimplementation, self-citation generator, epilectrik grammar; separate preregistration with provenance/hash/license.
